builds_on.phase1b_verdict: H2 (coupling degree) MIXED: C2, C3 pass; C1, C4 fail

design.validation_subset: stratified, 2000 rows of the validation split, seed 0
design.test_subset: stratified, min(4000, all) rows of the clean test split, seed 20261001; the same rows for every model

assignments.rank: qubit q receives feature q (features in importance order: PCA order or MI rank)
assignments.top_to_low_degree: most important features on lowest-degree qubits (heterogeneous graphs only)
assignments.top_to_high_degree: most important features on highest-degree qubits (heterogeneous graphs only)

design.quantum_kernel: projected 1-RDM kernel k(x,x') = exp(-gamma * sum_k ||rho_k(x)-rho_k(x')||_F^2); gamma = multiplier * 1/median distance on 500 training points; multipliers {0.5,1,2}; SVM C in {1,10,100}; class_weight balanced
design.tuning: hyperparameters chosen on the validation subset with the seed-0 training sample (macro-F1), then refit for every seed
design.comparators: on the identical training samples and test subset: RBF-SVM (Phase 0 grid) on the same 8 features, and the Phase 0 best classical model for that task, view and N (Phase 0 grid)

hypotheses.P1: Per-qubit concentration predicts usefulness: across feature-map configurations (assignment = rank) at N = 1000, the Spearman correlation between mean V (on the seed-0 training sample) and seed-averaged test macro-F1 is positive with p < 0.05 in at least 2 of the 3 tasks. Reported for N = 250 and 4000 as secondary.
hypotheses.P2: Feature-to-qubit assignment matters as predicted by Phase 1b's exploratory refinement: in paired comparisons (same task, heterogeneous graph, L, c, N; seed-averaged), top_to_low_degree beats top_to_high_degree in >= 70% of pairs with a positive median difference.
hypotheses.P3_comparison: Pre-specified, descriptive: for each task and N, the projected-kernel configuration with the best validation macro-F1 is compared on test with RBF-SVM and the best classical model (difference and bootstrap 95% CI over test rows, seed 0). Non-inferiority to RBF-SVM is declared if the lower CI bound of (PQK - RBF) is above -0.01.

decision.P3: reported per task and N; no pass/fail on the paper's claims
